item.title: Maumelle High School student arrested after bomb threat triggers evacuation
item.description: A student at Maumelle High School was arrested Monday morning after authorities say the school received a bomb threat through a school-issued device.

item.title: Pulaski County prosecutor candidates emphasize their approaches to violent crime
item.description: The two candidates on the ballot for Pulaski County Prosecutor were Incumbent Will Jones and opponent Bobby Forrest Jr., both of whom believed violent crime was a concern for the county. Still, each had a different idea for how to tackle it.

item.title: Over 30,000 in Pulaski County head to polls for early voting
item.description: Just a day until the election, early voting has wrapped up, and Pulaski County says over 30,000 voters turned out to the polls before the big day.

item.title: Little Rock church group stranded after Iran strikes expected home Wednesday
item.description: An Arkansas church group stranded in the Middle East after U.S. strikes on Iran disrupted regional air travel has secured flights home and is expected to return to Arkansas on Wednesday.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.

item.title: Maumelle High School evacuates after receiving bomb threat
item.description: Students and staff at Maumelle High School have evacuated after authorities said the school received a bomb threat Monday.
